description: An ordinary nested query receives original words without an inherited close constraint (engine §4 and §10).
grammar:
%rule text $x:candidate %conditions $x.without-elision.parse(rival)

%rule candidate (X [+T])
%rule rival $y:body %conditions $y.parse(raw), ¬($y.parse(bare))

%rule body (X [+T])
%rule raw (X [+U])
%rule bare (X T)
